APP (Atactic Polypropylene) modified bitumen membrane is a reinforced waterproofing sheet where the bitumen is modified with a plastomeric polymer. APP is the preferred specification for hot-climate regions (Middle East, Africa, South Asia, Southeast Asia) where roof surface temperatures regularly exceed 70°C.
